mapper.select: select comment.comment_uid as 'commentUid', comment.comment_time as 'commentTime', comment.user_uid as 'userUid', comment.comment as 'comment', user.nickname as 'userName' from test.blog_text_comment as comment, test.user as user where comment.text_uid = #{textUid} and comment.user_uid = user.uid and comment.comment_root_uid is null limit #{start} , 5;

select distinct comment.comment_uid as 'commentUid', comment.comment_time as 'commentTime', comment.user_uid as 'userUid', comment.comment as 'comment', user.nickname as 'userName', comment.comment_root_uid as 'commentRootUid', comment.comment_parent_uid as 'commentParentUid', user2.nickname as 'commentParentName' from test.blog_text_comment as comment, test.user as user, test.user as user2, test.blog_text_comment as comment2 where #{textUid} = comment.text_uid and comment.user_uid = user.uid and comment2.user_uid = user2.uid and comment.comment_root_uid = #{rootUid} and (comment.comment_parent_uid = comment2.comment_uid and comment2.user_uid = user2.uid or comment.comment_parent_uid is null and comment.user_uid = user2.uid) order by commentTime limit #{start} , 5;
